questions.question: In the study of Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy, what is the authoritative chemical definition of 'Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR)'?

options.label: A
options.text: The relative resonance frequency of a nucleus compared to a standard reference (tetramethylsilane, TMS at δ = 0 ppm), expressed in dimensionless parts per million (ppm).

options.label: B
options.text: A spectroscopic technique that observes transitions between quantized nuclear spin states of magnetic nuclei placed inside a strong external magnetic field.

options.label: C
options.text: The increase in effective magnetic field experienced by a nucleus when nearby electronegative atoms or magnetic anisotropy draw electron density away, shifting signals downfield.

options.label: D
options.text: The attenuation of the effective magnetic field felt by a nucleus caused by opposing magnetic fields generated by circulating surrounding electron density.

questions.correct_answer: A spectroscopic technique that observes transitions between quantized nuclear spin states of magnetic nuclei placed inside a strong external magnetic field.
